candidate.summary: Unconfirmed candidate with recurring dips near 2.71342 days. Supported source: TIC 358463507. The indexed TIC 358463513 observation contains this same blended signal. This is one candidate, not two independent signals. Planet, brown-dwarf, and stellar interpretations remain unresolved. Dedicated follow-up is deferred until more candidates are available.

notes.body: Richard defers dedicated follow-up until more candidates are available. Keep this signal in the candidate register. Later work must test omitted companion alternatives and resolve companion mass. Possible routes include calibrated orbital phase curves or source-resolved epoch velocities. Resolved transit photometry can strengthen source and shape checks. Known-object comparison must establish identity separately. Neither a paper nor an external submission establishes planet validation. This note schedules no work. The linked files remain external lab proposals, not platform measurements.
